chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad narrated from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Abu Dawud al-Mustarriq, from one of our companions, from Muthanna al-Hannat, from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (peace be upon him), who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'Whoever visits Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) recognizing his right, Allah (Exalted is He) will forgive him whatever preceded from his sins and whatever is delayed.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam Al-Husayn with recognition of his right?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from al-Kafi underscores that the efficacy of ziyarah (visitation) hinges on 'ma'rifah' (gnostic recognition) of Imam Al-Husayn’s unique spiritual station and right, rather than mere physical presence. This recognition serves as the key to comprehensive forgiveness, linking the intercessory power of the Ahl al-Bayt directly to the believer's conscious awareness of their Imamate. The emphasis on 'what preceded and what followed' suggests a holistic absolution that transcends temporal boundaries, reinforcing the eternal significance of the Karbala event in Shia soteriology.
